**In which case chiral carbon is not generated by reaction with HCN?**

```markdown
When HCN adds to a carbonyl compound, a chiral center is generated if the carbonyl carbon is attached to two different groups. If the carbonyl carbon has identical groups, the product will not be chiral. Option (a) shows a compound where the carbonyl carbon has identical groups, so no chiral center is formed.
Correct answer is (a).
```
